subject: math
description: Identify and describe the main parts of a cylinder, including radius, diameter, height, base, and curved surface, using everyday cans, tanks, and containers.
learningObjectives: Identify the two circular bases of a cylinder
Distinguish between radius and diameter on a circular base
Identify the height of a cylinder as the perpendicular distance between the bases
Describe the curved surface of a cylinder
Label cylinder models using correct measurement vocabulary
prerequisites: Recognize circles and basic three-dimensional solids
Know that a radius goes from the center of a circle to its edge
Know that a diameter goes across a circle through the center
